title: Fine asymptotics of the magnetization of the annealed dilute Curie-Weiss model
summary: We consider the dilute Curie-Weiss model of size $N$, which is a generalization of the classical Curie-Weiss model in which the dependency structure between the spins is encoded not by the complete graph but by the (directed) Erdős-Rényi graph on $N$ vertices in which every edge appears independently with probability $p(N)$.
